svg.title: Base-Case Revenue to $95,625 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-service-fee-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Base-Case Revenue to $95,625 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars reconcile $255,000 gross fees to a 37.5% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Expense categories are an illustrative allocation, not supplied scorecard line items. First and last bars are totals; intermediate negative bars are deductions. Total expenses are $159,375 annually, or $13,281.25 monthly, exceeding the supplied $1,500–$8,000 monthly opex band. That band cannot represent all-in Base expenses; only the modeled $4,000 monthly fixed-overhead component falls inside it.; caption: $255,000 − $48,000 − $66,000 − $25,500 − $19,875 = $95,625; $95,625 ÷ $255,000 = 37.5%.; stages: label: Recognized service fees; value: $255,000 annual operator revenue before modeled expenses; numeric value: 255000.0; detail: Starting total: 75 paid cases at $3,400 average fees. Exclude treasury disbursements belonging to owners and exclude unearned fees from unresolved claims.; label: Fixed operating overhead; value: Deduct $48,000 for recurring operating infrastructure; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 monthly to software, insurance, secure document handling, bookkeeping, and administration. Remaining annual contribution after this deduction is $207,000.; label: Contract case delivery; value: Deduct $66,000 for two contractors' delivery work; numeric value: -66000.0; detail: Budget researcher and claims-administrator capacity at $880 per completed case across 75 cases. Remaining annual contribution after this deduction is $141,000.; label: Research and acquisition; value: Deduct $25,500 for sourcing and owner engagement; numeric value: -25500.0; detail: Allocate record acquisition, permitted outreach, and unsuccessful prospect research at $340 per completed case. Remaining annual contribution is $115,500.; label: Verification and exceptions; value: Deduct $19,875 for evidence and exception handling; numeric value: -19875.0; detail: Allocate $265 per completed case to incremental certified records, identity checks, and specialist review. Keep these charges distinct from contractor delivery and fixed overhead.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $95,625 ending profit equals 37.5% of service fees; numeric value: 95625.0; detail: Ending total uses the canonical owner-net metric. Conservative remains $60,000 × 25% = $15,000; Scaled remains $450,000 × 50% = $225,000.

rect.title: label: Recognized service fees; value: $255,000 annual operator revenue before modeled expenses; numeric value: 255000.0; detail: Starting total: 75 paid cases at $3,400 average fees. Exclude treasury disbursements belonging to owners and exclude unearned fees from unresolved claims.

label: Fixed operating overhead; value: Deduct $48,000 for recurring operating infrastructure; numeric value: -48000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 monthly to software, insurance, secure document handling, bookkeeping, and administration. Remaining annual contribution after this deduction is $207,000.

label: Contract case delivery; value: Deduct $66,000 for two contractors' delivery work; numeric value: -66000.0; detail: Budget researcher and claims-administrator capacity at $880 per completed case across 75 cases. Remaining annual contribution after this deduction is $141,000.

label: Research and acquisition; value: Deduct $25,500 for sourcing and owner engagement; numeric value: -25500.0; detail: Allocate record acquisition, permitted outreach, and unsuccessful prospect research at $340 per completed case. Remaining annual contribution is $115,500.

label: Verification and exceptions; value: Deduct $19,875 for evidence and exception handling; numeric value: -19875.0; detail: Allocate $265 per completed case to incremental certified records, identity checks, and specialist review. Keep these charges distinct from contractor delivery and fixed overhead.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $95,625 ending profit equals 37.5% of service fees; numeric value: 95625.0; detail: Ending total uses the canonical owner-net metric. Conservative remains $60,000 × 25% = $15,000; Scaled remains $450,000 × 50% = $225,000.

text.title: Assumptions: Expense categories are an illustrative allocation, not supplied scorecard line items. First and last bars are totals; intermediate negative bars are deductions. Total expenses are $159,375 annually, or $13,281.25 monthly, exceeding the supplied $1,500–$8,000 monthly opex band. That band cannot represent all-in Base expenses; only the modeled $4,000 monthly fixed-overhead component falls inside it.
